summary.title: Serverless Framework - Build Serverless Applications on AWS
summary.one_liner: The Serverless Framework deploys APIs, scheduled tasks, workflows and event-driven apps to AWS Lambda, declared in YAML, with a paid dashboard for metrics, logs and team sharing.
takeaways: The Serverless Framework declares AWS Lambda functions and their triggers in YAML and deploys and wires them together automatically.
Plugins are available for extending serverless use-cases and integrating with other tools.
The Dashboard offers metrics, cross-invocation log queries, shared secrets and test events for teams.
The V4 CLI is free for individuals and organizations under $2M annual revenue; larger organizations pay $4 per credit (as low as $1 with discounts).
An agent setup path is provided: install with npm i -g serverless, then run serverless agent setup.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the Serverless Framework, an open-source tool for deploying APIs, scheduled tasks, workflows and event-driven applications to AWS Lambda. The page describes YAML-based declaration of functions and triggers, a plugin ecosystem, and a hosted dashboard for metrics, debugging, team sharing and multi-account visibility. It also covers SOC 2 Type II compliance, priority support and V4 CLI pricing, and includes a prompt for AI coding agents to install the framework. Most of the content is marketing, so technical depth is limited to the high-level feature list.
